notes.text: The recorded game ends with 28.Rdb1 Qc8 29.Qxc6. If Black accepts with ...bxc6, the b-file geometry lets White use both rooks; this is a strong tactical teaching moment. The arena observed a White-POV cross-node change from +0.58 to +4.95, but that is not a same-root move-regret measurement.
